name: Eagle Eye
text: Scout 3 path cards, then draw 1 path card.
flavor: When you were young, you and your father would climb the Mound of the Navigator and look over the Valley. From that high vantage, he taught you to see the subtlest movements and minute detail of the flora and fauna far below.

text: Choose up to 4 total moments or attributes not named Paths We’ve Roamed Before from any number of Ranger discards. Place the chosen cards facedown on the top of their Ranger’s fatigue stack.
flavor: As you walk the Valley, you recall the wisdom gained during the seasonal wanderings of your youth.

name: Strider

flavor: From the day you took your first steps, you haven't stopped moving. Your heart yearns to scale distant peaks and wander untrodden vistas. You continually look toward the horizon, never content to sit still.
plain_text: You can only commit this attribute when interacting with a trail.

name: Thick Air
text:
As you reach a lower spot in the tunnel, your vision begins to blur and your head begins to throb. Silaro warned you about this — certain heavier gases can settle in tunnels and become toxic. You reflexively cover your mouth and nose.
YOU CHOOSE: A) Turn back. Discard all [progress] from the location. If no [progress] is discarded, you suffer 3 fatigue. B) Continue forward, holding your breath. Add [progress] to the location equal to the number of cards in your hand, then place your hand on top of your fatigue stack.

name: Legacy of the Ancestors
text:
As you traverse the subterranean remnants of the arcology, your heart grows heavy as your mind is filled with thoughts of the original inhabitants of this place. How did the Estian civilization fall to such utter ruin?
EACH RANGER CHOOSES: A) Contemplate the question. Discard 2 [FOC] energy and gain 1 [SPI]. B) Pay your respects. Discard 2 [SPI] energy and gain 1 [FOC]. C) Focus on the present. Suffer 2 fatigue and gain 1 [FIT] or 1 [AWA].

name: Fresh Footprints
text:
You come across a section of the passage that no water or weather has touched. There, you see a footprint with the distinct tread of Qory Dane, the renowned cobbler from Spire. Someone with a nice pair of boots has been through here recently.
RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Track the footsteps. Perform a group test: [AWA] + [exploration]: Follow [2[per_ranger]] the tracks of whoever's down here to search the Artery or Arcology set for a human and shuffle them into the path deck. If you succeed by 3[per_ranger] or more, put them into play instead. B) Stay on your present course. Search the Arcology set for A Shadow in the Darkness and shuffle it into the path deck.

name: Cave-In!
text:
The ceiling groans, and there is terrible rumbling all around you. You have only moments to react before the chamber collapses around you!
If you see this card while scouting: You may discard it to scout 2 additional cards. Add 1[harm] to each card along the way. Then, perform a group test: [AWA] + [exploration]: Flee [2[per_ranger]] the area to add 1 [progress] to the location and to each feature in play. If you fail, each Ranger suffers 1 injury unless they discard 3 cards from their hand.

name: Glowing Gnat Cloud
text:
You hear a faint buzzing from up ahead, then see a tiny glowing dot. Then another. Then another. Soon, there is a cloud of the miniscule, glowing gnats swarming around your head, turning you into a beacon of light in the darkness.
YOU CHOOSE: A) I'd prefer to remain in shadow. [FIT] + [conflict]: Shoo [2] the gnats away to discard this moment. If you fail, resolve option B. B) Let them be. Attach this moment to a being or feature within reach. It gains illumination.

If you fail, move all cards within reach to along the way and suffer 1 injury.

text:
You come across the mostly-disintegrated, skeletal remains of what must have been one of the Estians, covered in centuries of fine rock dust. You wonder what fate befell them here.
YOU CHOOSE: A) Pay your respects. [SPI] + [connection]: Honor [2] the Estian's spirit to soothe 1 fatigue for every 2 effort. B) Leave them be. Discard 1 random card from your hand.

name: Electrical Disruption
text:
A partially caved-in wall reveals a piece of damaged machinery. Electricity crackles around an intact power cell. Seems a shame to let it go to waste. It may be dangerous, but you think you might be able to remove it.
YOU CHOOSE: A) Harness the machine's power. [FOC] + [reason]: Extract [2] the power cell, careful not to damage it to add 1 power or unique token to a machine or tech for every 2 effort. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. B) Avoid the unstable energy. Suffer 1 fatigue. Search the General set for Awakened Apparatus and put it into play.

If you fail, discard 3 total unique tokens from machines and/or tech cards in play. B) Pass it by. Search the General set for Awakened Apparatus and put it into play.

If <e>SPIRE FALLEN</e>: <f>...Reclaimers!</f> Search the General set for two Reclaimer Seekers and shuffle them into the path deck.

If you fail, each Ranger suffers 2 fatigue. B) Take the long way around. Discard 1[per_ranger] [progress] from among the location and features along the way.

name: Biting Flies
text:
You feel a surprisingly painful bite on your neck, then the back of your hand, then your face. A buzzing fills your ears as a cloud of tiny, biting flies begins to swarm you.
If you see this card while scouting: Set aside all other scouted cards, resolve this card, then continue the scouting as normal. Suffer 1 fatigue, then you may perform the following test. If you choose not to, resolve its fail effect: [FIT] + [conflict]: Swat [2] the infuriating insects to discard this moment. If you fail, shuffle it into the path deck.

name: A Cold Wind
text:
A biting wind pierces even the thick fabric of your cloak. It's common knowledge that no matter the season, the weather in the Valley can grow suddenly cold. You pause to consider building a small fire.
If the weather is not inclement, you're thankful for the breeze. Each Ranger soothes 1 fatigue. If the weather is inclement, add 2 tokens to it, then resolve the following: RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Build a fire. Search the General set for Campfire Remains and put it into play. B) Continue undaunted. Each Ranger suffers 2 fatigue.

name: A Little Lost
text:
It took you some time to notice, but eventually you realize that you've accidentally gone off-trail. You check your maps and scour your memory, but you are unsure which way to proceed from here.
If you see this card while scouting: You may discard it to scout 2 additional cards. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Backtrack. Shuffle the path discard into the path deck. If [per_ranger] or fewer cards were added to the path deck this way, each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue. B) Continue on your present course. Attach this moment to the location. Increase its presence by 1.

name: Ranger Report
text:
A shrill whistle reaches your ears, repeating with a familiar cadence—it is one of Mae's couriers sent out with the Ranger Report. If you can locate the source and whistle back, you can get details on the weather and other news.
Perform a group test: [FOC] + [exploration]: Locate [2[per_ranger]] the source of the whistle and receive the weather forecast to either add or discard [per_ranger] tokens from the weather. If you fail, the courier warns others in the area of impending weather. Search the path deck for the next human and discard them.

name: Distant Howls
text:
The melodious baying of a wolhund drifts across the landscape, a reminder that predators are constantly on the prowl. You must be mindful of your actions, lest they invite the attention of a hungry being seeking its next meal.
Perform a group test: [SPI] + [reason]: Reflect [2[per_ranger]] on all you've done today to have each Ranger return a card from their discard to their hand for every 2[per_ranger] effort. Then, whether you succeed or fail, each Ranger with food or tech in their Ranger discard searches the path deck and discard for the next predator and puts it into play.

name: Wind and Wear
text:
Dirt and the elements slowly wear out all technology; even Mora Orlin's precise carbon-forged creations aren't immune to the effects of the trail. You look down and realize that some of your gear is in dire need of maintenance.
YOU CHOOSE: A) Pause to perform some maintenance. [FOC] + [reason]: Repair [2] your weathered gear to add a unique token to one of your equipped tech for every 2 effort. If you fail, discard a gear from your play area or your hand. B) It'll be fine. Discard a gear from your hand or discard 3 unique tokens from among your equipped gear.

name: Tracks in the Dirt
text:
You come across a set of tracks heading across the beaten path. You consider following them. It might be wise to scout the area for predators.
RANGERS CHOOSE: A) See what's out there. Perform a group test: [AWA] + [reason]: Follow [1[per_ranger]] the tracks to scout 1[per_ranger] path cards. If the weather is inclement, this test's difficulty is [2[per_ranger]] instead. B) Ignore the tracks. Discard all [progress] from the being with the highest presence.

name: The Valley's Splendor
text:
During your training, Calypsa encouraged you to pause and bask in the beauty of the Valley anytime you could find a good vantage point. You spot just such a view off of a spur trail ahead.
RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Enjoy the view from the overlook. Discard 2[per_ranger] [progress] from the location. For each [progress] discarded this way, a Ranger may soothe 1 fatigue. B) Press forward. Add [per_ranger][progress] to the location as you stick to the path. Each Ranger must either exhaust their role or suffer 2 fatigue.

name: Rumbling Beneath Your Feet
text:
<f>The ground beneath your feet begins to move and shift.</f><hr>Draw a challenge card and resolve the corresponding effect:
[sun] <f>A sinkhole opens before you!</f> Search the Valley set for the Arcology Sinkhole and put it into play.
[mountain] Move each feature along the way to within reach of a Ranger, treating them as having Ambush.
[crest] Search the Swamp set for a Hydraworm and shuffle it into the path deck.

name: A Redolent Breeze
text:
The wind shifts, and the lovely scent of flowers in bloom fills the air. This particular bouquet isn't as common in this part of the Valley as it is in others. Perhaps if you followed your nose you might discover a flora rare to this region.
YOU CHOOSE: A) Follow the scent. [AWA] + [exploration]: Follow [2] your nose to search a terrain set that is not currently in use for a flora and put it into play. B) Enjoy the sweet air and continue onward. Soothe fatigue equal to the total presence of all flora in play.

name: A Perfect Camping Spot
text:
You see a wisp of smoke rising from a nearby hill. There, you find the remnants of a campfire at the center of what could only be called a perfect camping spot: a bit of shade, elevated, and secluded from view.
RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Take a break. Perform a group test: [SPI] + [reason]: Relax [2[per_ranger]] at the idyllic spot, then clean it up to swap rewards into your Ranger decks as if you had camped. You can displace cards from your hand, deck, or discard and add the rewards in the same location. Then, shuffle your deck. If you fail, resolve option B. B) Pass it by. Search the General set for Campfire Remains and put it into play.

name: A Pack Without an Owner
text:
You spot something out of place just off the trail: a ferroweave pack leaning up against a tree. Someone must be nearby. You wonder if perhaps you should check on them, just to make sure they're all right.
RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Search for the owner of the pack. Perform a group test: [AWA] + [exploration]: Locate [2[per_ranger]] the owner of the pack to search the Valley set for a human and shuffle them into the path deck. If you succeed by 3[per_ranger] or more, put them into play instead. Then return this card to the collection. B) No need to bother them. Search the path deck for the next human and discard them.

text:

[sun] <f>They look happy to see you!</f> Add 1[progress] to them.
[mountain] <f>They appear to be in the middle of a conversation.</f> Exhaust them and another human.
[crest] <f>Oh no, they look injured!</f> Add 1[harm] to them.

name: Breath of the Verdessa
text:
<f>A southern wind washes up the Silverfin and whistles through the buildings of Spire, bringing with it the heady scent of the Verdessa. Maybe it's your imagination, but you could swear that plants grow greener on days like these.</f><hr>If the weather is Wild Growth or Pollen Clouds, add 2 pollen to it.
Otherwise, return the weather to the collection and put Wild Growth into play in the surroundings with 2 pollen on it.

name: Market Sale
text:
You spot a crowd congregating around one of Spire's open-air markets. There's a sale going on! Maybe you can take some time out of your day to browse the market and barter for something useful.
RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Visit the market. Each Ranger searches their Ranger deck for a gear and reveals it. Then, perform a group test: [AWA] + [reason]: Browse [2[per_ranger]] the wares on display to have each Ranger draw the card they revealed. If you fail, each Ranger discards the card they revealed. B) Move past the crowd. Each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue. Add 1[per_ranger][progress] to a feature.

name: Up An Alley
text:
From a nearby rooftop, a strange bird with colorful plumage watches you with keen interest. Oddly enough, no one else seems to notice it. It flutters off into a nearby alleyway before you can approach.
If you see this card while scouting: You may discard it to scout 2 additional cards. Perform a group test: [AWA] + [exploration]: Follow [2[per_ranger]] the mysterious bird to search the General set for The Stranger and put it into play. If you fail, remove all [ranger] from cards in play.

name: Tempting Melody
text:
The sound of a plucky mandolin catches your attention. A talespinner is joyfully playing music, and several passersby have flocked around them to listen. You wonder whether you have time to catch a song or two.
RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Stay awhile and listen. Each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue. Then, perform a group test: [SPI] + [connection]: Listen [1[per_ranger]] to the music to soothe fatigue among the Rangers equal to the group's effort. B) We'll meet again. Discard all [progress] from each human within reach of a Ranger and move each of them along the way.

name: Silverfin Spillover
text:
You hear cries of townsfolk several buildings down and see water beginning to creep along the ground towards you. The Silverfin has a habit of spilling over its banks this time of year, and it looks to be doing so again.
Perform a group test: [FIT] + [reason]: Build [2[per_ranger]] a temporary dike alongside the other residents to scout 1 path card for every 1[per_ranger] effort. If you fail, shuffle 1[per_ranger] random cards from the River set and place them on top of the path deck. Then, draw 1 path card.

name: Ominous Skies
text:
Even among the carbon-forged buildings of Spire, the people of the village must still respect the power of nature. You watch people taking shelter as the weather worsens.
If the weather is neither inclement nor hot, flip it. RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Take shelter. Discard 1[per_ranger][progress] from the location as you pause to take shelter. For each [progress] discarded this way, you may add 1[progress] to a human. B) Press forward. Add 1[per_ranger][progress] to the location. Resolve each challenge effect on the weather in an order of your choice.

name: Going in Circles
text:
<f>Wait... haven't you seen that building before? You're so used to navigating by the unique hills, trails, and trees of the Valley that it's difficult to find your way within all these carbon-forged structures.</f><hr>If there are 1 or more cards in the path discard, shuffle them and place them on top of the path deck.
If there are no cards in the path discard, shuffle this card into the top 4 cards of the path deck instead.

name: Lingering Manifestation
text:
You hear the whistling of the wind before you feel it. Then suddenly, air rushes around you, sending your cloak flying upwards! Some strange energy is causing an inexplicable updraft in just this one spot.
Each Ranger returns one of their equipped gear to their hand as the wind catches it in the updraft. If at least one of the Rangers is a Shaper, you may perform a group test: [FOC] + [conflict]: Harness [2[per_ranger]] the energy to have each Ranger equip a gear from their hand (without paying its energy cost). If the group's effort is 3[per_ranger] or more, each Shaper may return a card from their hand to the collection. Then they can choose a starting manifestation from the collection that they meet the aspect requirement for and add it to their hand. (This alteration to their deck is permanent.)

name: Spark of Inspiration
text:
The rhythm of the trail, whether challenging or steady, gives you time to think. Sometimes it's meditative, other times, inspiration strikes!
Perform a group test: [FOC] + [reason]: Capture [2[per_ranger]] the inspiring moment to have each Ranger search their Ranger deck for a card and add it to their hand. If you fail, each Ranger shuffles a card from their hand into their fatigue stack as the thought slips away.

name: Slippery Slope
text:
As you crest the top of a hill, you lose your footing - this side of the slope is covered in a sheet of ice!
If you see this card while scouting: You may discard it. [FIT] + [reason]: Regain [2] your footing to avoid slipping and falling. If you fail, suffer 1 injury and move each card within reach to along the way.

name: A World of Gray
text:
What little sunlight pierced the dark gray clouds before is now blotted out by thick fog. You can barely see more than a few meters in front of you.
If you see this card while scouting: Set aside all other scouted cards, resolve this card, then shuffle the set-aside scouted cards and place them back on top of the path deck. Place this card in the surroundings. While this card is in play, it gains the following text: Rangers cannot scout. [AWA] + [exploration]: Find [2] a spot of sunlight to discard this moment. (This card will be discarded along with other path cards when you travel.)

name: Weather Machinery
text:
What is this? A piece of machinery lies half-buried in the ground. Fog issues from a tear along its length. Perhaps if you repaired it, you could improve the weather conditions in your immediate vicinity.
RANGERS CHOOSE: A) Try to fix the device. Perform a group test: [FOC] + [reason]: Repair [2[per_ranger]] the machinery to either add 2 tokens to or discard 2 tokens from the weather. Then, you may flip the weather. If you fail, each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue. B) Let it be. Search the Nimbus set for a Deep Fog and put it into play.

name: Eyes in the Mist
text:
<f>In the distance, you spot a pair of eyes glowing in the mist. A hungry predator? Or something else?</f><hr>Either suffer 2 fatigue, or draw a challenge card and resolve the corresponding effect:
[sun] Search the General set for The Stranger and put it into play.
[mountain] Search the path deck and discard for the next prey and put it into play.
[crest] Search the path deck and discard for the next predator and put it into play, treating it as having ambush.

name: Whispers from Afar
text:
The wind picks up around you, and within its howling you hear a sound halfway between a whisper and a shriek. Is it just a figment of your imagination? Or are the spirits trying to tell you something?
Each Ranger reveals 1 card at random from their hand. Then... EACH RANGER CHOOSES: A) Heed the spirits. Discard the revealed card to scout Ranger cards equal to its energy cost. B) Ignore the sound. Place the revealed card on the bottom of your fatigue stack. C) Stay wary. Discard 2 [FOC] or 2 [AWA] energy to keep the revealed card in your hand. If you cannot, choose another option.

name: Avalanche!
text:
A sudden crash sounds in the distance, followed by a thundering roar. On the horizon, a wall of snow is rapidly approaching.
Perform one or both of the following group tests (Rangers choose): [FIT] + [exploration]: Dash [2[per_ranger]] out of the avalanche's path to add 2[per_ranger] [progress] to a feature. [AWA] + [exploration]: Search [2[per_ranger]] for cover to exhaust beings with up to 2[per_ranger] total presence. If you fail either test, discard all [progress] from the location and each Ranger suffers 1 injury. (Choosing not to perform one of the tests does not count as failure.)

name: Frigid Winds
text:
<f>A sudden gust of wind carries with it the promise of snow. You wrap your cloak around your body against the bitter chill.</f><hr>If the weather is Blizzard, discard all snow from it as heavy winds pick up a flurry of snow.
If the weather is Pristine Snow, discard 2 snow from it and flip it as the blizzard begins to rage.
If the weather is not cold, snow starts to fall. Return the weather to the collection and replace it with Blizzard.

name: On Thin Ice
text:
As you trudge through a barren field of snow, you hear a crack and realize you are standing atop a frozen pond. You'd better watch your step, or you'll wind up in freezing-cold water!
If you see this card while scouting: You may discard it. Attach this moment to your role. Response: After you Traverse, if you failed, or if your effort was 5 or more, the ice cracks! Discard this moment and suffer 3 fatigue. Response: When you travel, discard this card.

name: In Digestion
text:
Even a single drop of the Terravore's digestive juices can spell ruin for your gear. You hear the sizzling sound of it eating through something important and immediately scramble to clean it off.
Add 1 ichor to the weather. If the weather is not Acidic Ichor, flip it. You may perform the following test. If you choose not to, resolve its fail effect: [FOC] + [reason]: Mend [X] your partially digested gear to prevent it from breaking. If you fail, discard your equipped gear with the highest equip value. X is the amount of ichor on the weather.

YOU CHOOSE: A) Compose yourself. [SPI] + [conflict]: Steel [2] your resolve to add 1[progress] to the location for every 2 effort. If you fail, discard a random card from your hand. B) Voice your fears. Each Ranger suffers 1 fatigue.
